audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for Week 5 pose, view, garment, and silhouette identification.
audio_prompts.script: Look at the four figures. Number one: This figure is standing in a front view. The figure is wearing a simple dress. The dress has short sleeves, and the hem is below the knee. Number two: This figure is in a side view. The figure is wearing a jacket and pants. The pose is relaxed. Number three: This figure is walking. The figure is wearing a blouse and a skirt. The silhouette is long and simple. Number four: This figure is standing with one hand on the hip. The figure is wearing a fitted top and wide pants.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom instructor speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, clear, and easy to follow, with short pauses after each numbered figure description.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher.
